title: E-bike battery safety rules and certification for a US bike shop
variant: Bullets as a two-column grid of cards, one warning catch
prompt: TLDR on e-bike battery safety rules and certification in the US for a bike shop owner.
note: The bullets are a two-column grid of small cards rather than a list, because a shop owner will scan for the one that touches their floor (insurance, storage, shipping) rather than read in order, and the catch is the only warning-toned card and spans the row so it cannot be skimmed past. The one figure is a six-bar inline SVG beside the headline, since the fire count is the argument for everything below it and photographs better than a table would.
